name: The Fractal Continuum (Hard)
guide: There are two chimeras, stun or interrupt the dragon/ram casts if pulling them together
[[Allagan Gravity]] leaves puddles that will pull you in and damage/debuff
[[Citadel Buster]] be ready to quickly stand behind the bits when they form a line
Players with [[Infinite Fire]] or [[Infinite Ice]] debuffs should stand in the matching circles
[[Green markers]] will leave puddles that grow over time, and will be followed by a stack marker
Players with [[Black]] and [[White]] circles should pair up
Stay out of LOS of the mobs behind glass to prevent them escaping
[[Death Spin]] untelegraphed melee AOE - run out
[[Aether Bend]] untelegraphed donut AOE - run in
